description:
This Stunning Property represents the pinnacle of Modern luxury, perfectly combining sophisticated architerctural design with functional family living. The property makes an immediate impression with its striking red brick facade complemented by its large cobblelocked driveway to front providing parking for up to 3 cars. The vendors have been the owners of this stunning home since its construction and the care and attention to detail with which they have decorated and maintained and indeed extended the property is obvious for all to see. Comprising Entrance Hall, WC, Sittingroom, Large Open plan Kitchen/Dining/Living,  Utility, 4 Double Bedrooms with 1 Ensuite and Bathroom on First Floor and stunning Master Bedroom with Walk-in Wardrobe and beautiful Ensuite on the 2nd floor, the property spans c 176 sq meters having been extended and is simply outstanding,   providing all the possible attributes and benefits that any growing family may need over an extended period of time.  Boasting an excellent B2 Ber Energy Rating with its Boiler replaced only 3 years ago, the windows are Rationel Double Glazed AluClad and the front and side Bay windows have been powder coated standing  seam aluminium fitted above to match the colour of the window frames. The Attic Conversion has Full Planning Permission for use as a Master with Ensuite and Walk-in Wardrobe fully certified by an Architect for Compliance with Planning and Building Regulations.  While there is a full list below under ' Additional Features ' of the many extras and benefits with this property, we must also emphasise its fantastic central location within a short 3 minute stroll of 2 National Primary Schools, a 6 minute walk to Greenfield Shopping Centre and the recently extended Lidl supermarket, there is a Bus stop at the entrance to the Griffin Rath Development and the fantastic Train commuter service is also within a 12 minute walk of the property. Located within a 15 minute walk of the centre of the University town of Maynooth and all the many amenities on offer and present such as Shops, Restaurants, Cafes, Sporting and Recreational amenities and indeed beautiful walks such as the Greenway along the Canal and the renowned Carton Avenue walk, the Property is ideally placed for quick access to the nearby M4 Motorway, which connects Dublin to the West and Northwest of Ireland and is only 20 kilometres from the M50.
It is rare to find a Property which provides excellent size and scale, the superb standard of its build and fittings and the amazing central location this Property offers alongside the excellent B Energy Rating which ensures discounted Green Mortgage interest rates for any buyer and therefore viewing by appointment with the Agent Brid Feely MIPAV is very highly recommended.
